text:
Sam (Finance Ops): FYI: HelioCare wants a 12mo commit with Net45, a $6k onboarding credit, and a hard overage cap of $6k/mo. Need quick approval to meet procurement timeline.
Lina (AE): Signed SOW pending pricing appendix. Procurement requires the cap or they pause.
Sam (Finance Ops): Proposed: Commit $72k/yr, tiers: 0-600k @ $0.00055, >600k @ $0.00050, onboarding credit $6k, cap $6k/mo months 1-3, then $3k/mo months 4-12 conditional.
Oliver (RevOps): We can implement cap as invoice credit. Will need BR ticket; prefer conditional cap to reduce exposure.
Maya (Legal): Hard caps worry me. Suggest guarantee for months 1-3, then conditional on >=80% usage for months 2-3. Add audit & anti-abuse.
Ravi (CFO): Send model. Margin floor must be >=60% post-credits. If so, I can approve with the usage gate and clawback.
Lina (AE): Procurement deadline tomorrow EOD. I'll push to accept staged cap.
deal-bot: Deal updated: HelioCare - Opp 2026-099 - special pricing request created. (link) :paperclip:
Sam (Finance Ops): I'll run P&L and post here in 2h. Oliver, please open BR ticket once legal OK.
Oliver (RevOps): Ticket created #BR-9921 after Legal sign-off. ETA 48 hours for invoice logic.
Ravi (CFO): Approve conditioned on Maya's clauses + RevOps alerts for >15% variance.
Maya (Legal): Drafted appendix and sent to Lina. Routing for signature after AE confirm.
Lina (AE): Customer agreed to staged cap with gate. I'll get appendix signed today.
Sam (Finance Ops): Marking as approved-exception in pricing registry once doc signed. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
